name: Wicked Thorns
text:
Trigger You're hit with an unarmed Strike or a Strike with a non-reach melee weapon.

Frequency once per day

---
Several of your thorns break off and hook into your attacker's body. You deal ceil(@actor.level/2d8) piercing damage to the triggering creature. It attempts a basic Reflex save save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. On a critical failure, the creature also takes 1d4+ceil(@actor.level/2-1) bleed damage as your thorns embed in its flesh.

At 3rd level, and every 2 levels thereafter, this damage increases by 1d8, and the persistent bleed damage increases by 1.
